en.title: Muslim Marriage Registration in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: A Muslim marriage should be properly recorded through the lawful Nikah Registrar system. Keep the kabinnama and any certified copy safely. Registration creates an official record and helps prove important terms such as the parties, date and dower.

atAGlance.whoFor: A Muslim couple wants to understand marriage registration and documents.
atAGlance.mainRule: A Muslim marriage should be properly recorded through the lawful Nikah Registrar system. Keep the kabinnama and any cert
atAGlance.updateStatus: Check any current registrar forms, fees and digital services before publication.

en.lawMeaning:
The registration law gives Nikah Registrars duties relating to registration of Muslim marriages and divorces.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Check both parties’ names, age and identity details.
Collect and keep the kabinnama/certified copy.
Correct errors through the proper process.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A couple notices the bride’s name is misspelled on the kabinnama. They should use the proper correction process instead of relying on an informal handwritten change.
en.specialistTrigger: Age/child-marriage issue; forced marriage; disputed marriage; foreign documents; identity mismatch.
en.disclaimer:
This page provides general legal information about Bangladesh. It is not individual legal advice. Laws, procedures, fees and official instructions can change. Check the cited primary sources before taking action.
